assessments.quote: To construct an artificial neural network (ANN) capable of accurately predicting MVI presence in HCC using magnetic resonance imaging.
assessments.reason: 2024 study using MRI features and ANN to predict MVI in HCC; reports AUC 0.79 and variable correlations. Population, task, modality and timeframe match.

assessments.quote: we present a fully automatic system for predicting MVI in HCC based on preoperative MRI
assessments.reason: 2024 multicenter MRI radiomics plus deep-learning segmentation system predicting MVI in HCC, with AUC results. Directly matches population, task, modality and recent timeframe.

assessments.quote: develop and validate a radiogenomics nomogram for predicting microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) on the basis of MRI and microRNAs
assessments.reason: 2024 study building an MRI plus miRNA nomogram to predict MVI in HCC, reporting validation AUC 0.900. Matches population, prediction task, MRI modality and timeframe.

assessments.quote: predict MVI in ICCA and to evaluate their prognostic utility using a multicenter cohort
assessments.reason: Population is intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, not hepatocellular carcinoma; violates the required liver cancer population as specified (HCC).

assessments.quote: develop an interpretable, domain-generalizable deep learning model for microvascular invasion (MVI) assessment in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)
assessments.reason: 2025 multicenter MRI deep-learning study predicting MVI in HCC with external validation and discussion of interpretability/generalizability limitations. Direct match.

assessments.quote: To develop a nomogram for preoperative assessment of microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) based on the radiological features of enhanced CT
assessments.reason: Predicts MVI in HCC but primary model is CT-based; MRI only used for external validation. Modality constraint not fully met.

assessments.quote: evaluates the diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence models, including machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), in predicting MVI in HCC using imaging modalities such as CT, MRI, ultrasound, PET/CT, and histopathology
assessments.reason: Systematic review/meta-analysis covering multiple modalities including MRI for MVI prediction in HCC; useful overview but not an MRI-specific primary study and covers 2010-2023, partly outside recent three years.

assessments.quote: a retrospective cohort study of recurrence timing and survival after curative resection of hepatocellular carcinoma
assessments.reason: Focuses on recurrence timing and survival using CTC and pathological MVI grade; no MRI-based MVI prediction. Also dated 2026, outside recent three years.

assessments.quote: Primary Malignant Neoplasms of the Liver
assessments.reason: General chapter on primary liver malignancies; no MRI-based MVI prediction study. Dated 2026, outside timeframe.
